routines.name: Weekly genre scout
routines.input: Scout this week's genres for the desk-props pack (product key pngtuber-prop-pack): 2 currently popular AAA titles and 2 indie titles with active streaming communities, from public popularity signals only. Write the internal notes and 4 genre briefs.
